scene nodokaupagain3
: Fucking hippocampus. Fucking norepinephrine. Fucking pre-frontal cortex and fucking REM and fucking stupid fucking {i}bathtub.{/i}
lines.zh: : 该死的海马体。该死的去甲肾上腺素。该死的前额叶皮层，还有该死的快速眼动，还有该死的愚蠢的该死{i}浴缸{/i}。

lines.en: : If I could just remember what happens in my sleep, I could be rid of these blasted headaches once and for all. But alas — I must suffer. I must raise the water bill.
lines.zh: : 只要我能记住自己睡着时发生了什么，我就能一次性摆脱这些该死的头痛。可惜——我必须受苦。我必须把水费涨上去。

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain4
: One woe doth tread upon another’s heel! So fast they follow. Your sister’s drowned, Laertes!
lines.zh: : 一重灾祸踏着另一重的脚跟！它们跟得那么紧。你姐姐淹死了，Laertes！

lines.en: : There is a willow grows askant the brook that shows his hoar leaves in the glassy stream.
lines.zh: : 小溪之旁斜长着一株柳树，它灰白的叶子倒映在如镜的水面上。

lines.en: : Therewith fantastic garlands did she make of crowflowers, nettles, daisies, and long purples that liberal shepherds give a grosser name...but our cold maids do “dead men’s fingers” call them...
lines.zh: : 她用毛茛、荨麻、雏菊和长长的紫兰编成奇异的花环——放纵的牧羊人给它们起了个粗俗的名字……而我们冷洁的姑娘们却叫它们「死人的手指」……

lines.en: : Fuck you, Shakespeare. Fuck you, Laertes. This body belongs not to Ophelia nor Hamlet, but {i}me.{/i} And shall I be swallowed by the waves of these perpetual days, be it known that my passing is involuntary.
lines.zh: : 去你的，莎士比亚。去你的，Laertes。这具身体既不属于 Ophelia，也不属于 Hamlet，而属于{i}我。{/i}若我将被这无尽之日的一道道浪涛吞没，须知我的逝去并非出于自愿。

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain5
: Sound the bells nestled in their rocky dwellings. Let their cries recant my disappearance and carry my ashes once more over beds of blue hydrangeas, pruned by men of lesser color.
lines.zh: : 敲响那些嵌在岩石巢穴里的钟吧。让它们的哭声收回我的消失，让我的骨灰再一次飘过蓝色的绣球花丛——那些由肤色更浅的人修剪的花丛。

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain6
: I have completed my mandatory reunion with hygiene! Too much of water hast I! Poor Nodoka! Terrible Nodoka! This woman is out! Adieu, my lord! Adieu!
lines.zh: : 我已经完成了与 Hygiene 的强制性重聚！我身上的水太多了！可怜的 Nodoka！糟糕的 Nodoka！这个女人出局了！再会，我的主！再会！

lines.en: : Let’s follow Gertrude!
lines.zh: : 我们跟 Gertrude 走吧！

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain7
: I’m doing fine. Thank you for asking.
lines.zh: : 我很好。谢谢关心。

lines.en: : I must return to the dorms tonight. Remaining here any longer will only drive me deeper into madness.
lines.zh: : 今晚我必须回宿舍。再在这儿待下去，只会把我逼向更深的疯狂。

lines.en: : There’s news, though.
lines.zh: : 不过有个消息。

lines.en: : Rejoice. The world is broken.
lines.zh: : 欢庆吧。世界坏掉了。

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain8
: And while that isn’t that grand of a surprise, something else is.
lines.zh: : 虽然这算不上什么大惊喜，但另一件事是。

lines.en: : I’m not the only one who knows it.
lines.zh: : 我不是唯一一个知道的人。

lines.en: : I’ve stumbled into someone else’s party without an invitation. Is this how it feels to be popular?
lines.zh: : 我误闯了别人的派对，还没带请柬。受欢迎就是这个感觉吗？

lines.en: : Don’t answer that. I know you were about to.
lines.zh: : 别回答。我知道你刚要开口。

lines.en: : You’re so full of life these days. Chatting up a storm. A tempest, even. Preventing me from leaving. Sleeping.
lines.zh: : 你最近真是活力四射。聊个不停。简直是一场暴风雨。不让我离开。不让我睡觉。

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain9
: Oh, the things I’d do for silence. To feel at peace even once.
lines.zh: : 哦，为了沉默，我什么都愿意做。哪怕只感受到一次平静也好。

lines.en: : Kyoko...
lines.zh: : Kyoko……

lines.en: : What am I?
lines.zh: : 我是什么？

lines.en: : What would become of you if I were to stop showing up one day?
lines.zh: : 如果有一天我不再出现了，你会变成什么样？

lines.en: : Humans can only last up to a week without water.  But does such a word even apply to us?
lines.zh: : 人类没有水最多只能撑一周。可那样的字眼，到底适用于我们吗？

lines.en: : Are we really human if we can not die? If we were never born?
lines.zh: : 如果我们不会死，我们真的算是人类吗？如果我们从未出生过？

lines.en: : {i}Would{/i} you die? Were {i}you{/i} born?
lines.zh: : 你{i}会{/i}死吗？{i}你{/i}出生过吗？

lines.en: : And, if you won’t die, how long would you stay in that chair? Staring at that screen.
lines.zh: : 而如果你不会死，你会在那把椅子里坐多久？盯着那块屏幕。

lines.en: : I sometimes wish my world was as small as yours.
lines.zh: : 有时候我真希望我的世界跟你的一样小。

lines.en: : That someone would bathe me. Feed me. Protect me.
lines.zh: : 希望有人给我洗澡。喂我吃饭。保护我。

lines.en: : Hug me.
lines.zh: : 抱抱我。

lines.en: : I don’t intend to burden you with such intimate contact.
lines.zh: : 我无意用这样亲密的接触来拖累你。

lines.en: : But I think about it sometimes.
lines.zh: : 但我有时候会想。

lines.en: : And we can discuss if such a thing would be acceptable or not once you wake up.
lines.zh: : 至于那样的事到底能不能接受，我们可以等你醒来之后再讨论。

lines.en: : I’m getting closer. I can feel it.
lines.zh: : 我离得越来越近了。我能感觉到。

lines.en: : Do you even {i}want{/i} to wake up, though?
lines.zh: : 可你到底想{i}不想{/i}醒来呢？

lines.en: : Does this make me selfish, I wonder?
lines.zh: : 我在想，这会不会让我变得自私？

lines.en: : I enjoyed this conversation. But I apologize that I was naked for it.
lines.zh: : 我很享受这次对话。但很抱歉，我是光着身子说的。

lines.en: scene black
scene nodokaupagain10
: Good morning, Mr. Blake. Or shall I say good evening? Could I trouble you for the time in exchange for this bit of bread?
lines.zh: : 早上好，Blake 先生。或者该说晚上好？我能不能用这块面包跟你换一下时间？

lines.en: : Nodoka! Nodoka! Scrawk! Happy! Happy! Scrawk!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！Nodoka！嘎！开心！开心！嘎！

lines.en: : Are you {i}truly{/i} happy, Mr. Blake? I can’t imagine it’s enjoyable living inside of a cabinet like this. Animal control would surely seize you if they knew.
lines.zh: : 你{i}真的{/i}开心吗，Blake 先生？我想住在这样的柜子里不会有多愉快。要是动物管制的人知道了，肯定会把你抓走。

lines.en: : Scrawk! Happy! Happy! A gift for God! A gift for God!
lines.zh: : 嘎！开心！开心！献给神的礼物！献给神的礼物！

lines.en: : Now now, Mr. Blake. If I give you this bread, you need to promise {i}not{/i} to use it as a tribute to the deity of your choice. This is an atheist household, I’ll have you know.
lines.zh: : 好了好了，Blake 先生。如果我给你这块面包，你得保证{i}不{/i}把它当祭品献给你选中的神明。我得告诉你，这是个无神论家庭。

lines.en: : Scraaaawk! Shiori-chan! Shiori-chan! Scraaaaawk!
lines.zh: : 嘎啊啊啊！Shiori 酱！Shiori 酱！嘎啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain11
: Kyoko doesn’t like it when you use that name.
lines.zh: : Kyoko 不喜欢你用那个名字。

lines.en: : You best watch your tongue or you’ll wind up in our next hot pot, Mr. Blake.
lines.zh: : 你最好管好你的舌头，不然下次火锅里就是你，Blake 先生。

lines.en: : Scrawwwk! Scrawk! Sorry! Scrawk! Very sorry!
lines.zh: : 嘎啊啊！嘎！对不起！嘎！非常对不起！

lines.en: : An apology is unnecessary. I’ll bring you better food tomorrow. I didn’t realize we were out.
lines.zh: : 道歉就不必了。我明天给你带更好吃的。我不知道家里已经吃完了。

lines.en: : Would you like to sit on her shoulder? Do you promise to walk yourself home if I let you out?
lines.zh: : 你想坐到她肩膀上去吗？如果我放你出来，你保证自己走回家吗？

lines.en: : Promise! Scrawk! Happy! Happy!
lines.zh: : 保证！嘎！开心！开心！

lines.en: scene black
: Kyoko, Mr. Blake would like to see you. Are you accepting visitors at the moment?
lines.zh: : Kyoko，Blake 先生想见你。你现在方便见客吗？

lines.en: : Scrawk! Scraaaaaawk!
lines.zh: : 嘎！嘎啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Mr. Blake. If you haven’t noticed, Kyoko is rather busy at the moment and isn’t accepting company.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Blake 先生。如果你没注意到的话，Kyoko 现在挺忙的，不会客。

lines.en: : SCRAWWWK! Scraaaawk! Sacrifice! Sacrifice!
lines.zh: : 嘎啊啊啊！嘎啊啊啊！献祭！献祭！

lines.en: : Okay, okay. There’s no need to make any sacrifices either.
lines.zh: : 好好好。也没必要搞什么献祭。

lines.en: : Here. Have at her. Can you pluck her feathers in my absence? The way I do yours?
lines.zh: : 给。随你处置。我不在的时候，你能替我拔拔她的羽毛吗？就像我拔你的那样。

lines.en: : Where going? Scraaawk! Where going?
lines.zh: : 去哪儿？嘎啊啊！去哪儿？

lines.en: : I won’t be long.
lines.zh: : 我不会去很久。

lines.en: : It’s just the other side of the weeping brook...
lines.zh: : 就在那条哭泣的小溪的另一边……

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain12
Nodoka Nagasawa was used to the dark.
lines.zh: Nodoka Nagasawa 早就习惯了黑暗。

lines.en: In fact, she found it easier to apply her makeup that way.
lines.zh: 事实上，她发现那样上妆更容易。

lines.en: Kyoko reacted to the lights, so they weren’t used often.
lines.zh: Kyoko 对光有反应，所以灯不常开。

lines.en: Not much here {i}was{/i} used often.
lines.zh: 这里的大多数东西都不常被使用。

lines.en: It was mainly just a computer. A hot plate. The water.
lines.zh: 主要就是一台电脑。一块加热板。还有水。

lines.en: Even the outlet beside the cot where Nodoka slept on visits was a virgin.
lines.zh: 就连 Nodoka 来访时睡的那张行军床旁边的插座，都还是处子之身。

lines.en: She didn’t use her phone here. Kyoko reacted to that too.
lines.zh: 她在这儿不用手机。Kyoko 对那个也有反应。

lines.en: All of these “reactions” were subtle, though.
lines.zh: 不过，所有这些「反应」都很细微。

lines.en: So subtle that the laymen like you would never pick up on them.
lines.zh: 细微到像你这样的外行永远察觉不到。

lines.en: A daughter could, though.
lines.zh: 但一个女儿可以。

lines.en: A “daughter” could.
lines.zh: 一个「女儿」可以。

lines.en: : I’m stealing some of your clothes. I didn’t bring any extras with me this time.
lines.zh: : 我要顺走你几件衣服。这次我没带多余的。

lines.en: : Take care.
lines.zh: : 保重。

lines.en: scene black
: I will see you soon.
lines.zh: : 我们很快会再见。

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain13
Even disregarding who she was and how she got here, Nodoka Nagasawa was an interesting specimen.
lines.zh: 姑且不论她是谁、是怎么到这儿来的，Nodoka Nagasawa 本身就是一个有趣的标本。

lines.en: Drifting back and forth between the public eye and what I’ve come to know as the eyelid that shields us from worlds unseen, she was both two people at once and also no one at all.
lines.zh: 她在公众视野与那层为我们遮蔽不可见世界的眼睑之间来回漂移，既同时是两个人，又什么人都不是。

lines.en: {size=-2}This sort of thing would be difficult for anyone else. But considering she was none of them and all of them, two lives weren’t that hard to balance. And there was no reason to really {i}merge{/i} them either.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}这种事对任何别人来说都会很难。但考虑到她既不是她们中的任何一个、又同时是她们全部，平衡两条人生倒不算太难。而且也没有理由非要把它们合二为一。{/size}

lines.en: Kyoko would be kept a secret. It was safer for her that way. And it was easier for Nodoka as well because dealing with “sympathy” was never something she was good at.
lines.zh: Kyoko 会被当成秘密保守。那样对她更安全。对 Nodoka 来说也更轻松，因为应付「同情」从来不是她擅长的事。

lines.en: She was good at sponge baths, though. Helping people chew their food. Changing their clothes and brushing their hair.
lines.zh: 不过她擅长海绵擦浴。擅长帮人咀嚼食物。擅长给人换衣服、梳头。

lines.en: Making sure they always looked as pretty as they were described by their peers in old notebooks that faded in and out of existence whenever they weren’t being looked at.
lines.zh: 擅长确保她们看起来，永远像旧笔记本里同辈人描述的那样漂亮——而那些笔记本，只要没人看着，就忽隐忽现。

lines.en: And as she marched down a road she could see with her eyes closed, she hoped the same was true of her mother.
lines.zh: 而她沿着那条她闭着眼都能看见的路往前走时，她希望她母亲也是如此。

lines.en: That, in leaving, Nodoka was doing her a favor and suspending her existence somewhere between whatever it was she experienced so many years ago and all she struggles to experience today.
lines.zh: 希望 Nodoka 的离开算是帮了她一个忙——把她悬置在她多年前经历过的那个什么、与她如今挣扎着想要经历的一切之间。

lines.en: She had never heard her voice. She had never felt her embrace. And she had never seen her stand.
lines.zh: 她从未听过她的声音。她从未感受过她的拥抱。她也从未见过她站起来。

lines.en: {size=-2}Everything Nodoka had ever learned about her mother was something someone else learned first — so the entire {i}concept{/i} of “family” was something essentially passed down through an endless game of telephone.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}Nodoka 学到的关于母亲的一切，都是别人先学到的——所以「家人」这整个概念，本质上是通过一场无尽的传话游戏传递下来的。{/size}

lines.en: It’d be easy to just abandon her. To falsify some tragic tale ending with her passing and move on to realizing the ambitions everyone assumes she has when what she really wants is far more simple than that.
lines.zh: 抛弃她很容易。编一个以她的离世收场的悲惨故事，然后继续去实现每个人都以为她有的那些抱负——而她真正想要的，远比那简单得多。

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain14
This creature cared not for gods or their angels. For contracts or constructs like time or language. Those were all just monsters she was forced to wrestle on the way back home.
lines.zh: 这个生物不在乎什么神或天使。也不在乎时间或语言之类的契约与建构。那些都只是她在回家路上被迫搏斗的怪物。

lines.en: It was a long, depressing journey though. And one that seemed even {i}longer{/i} all of a sudden now that the monsters were evolving and adapting to this sick place we’ve found ourselves in.
lines.zh: 可那是一段漫长而压抑的旅程。而当那些怪物开始进化、开始适应我们陷身其中的这个病态之地时，这段旅程似乎突然变得{i}更长{/i}了。

lines.en: This infinite emptiness, this unending struggle where self battles seraphim was naught but the residue  of prior collapses bubbling up until we’re all worried it will trigger the smoke alarms.
lines.zh: 这无垠的空虚，这自我与炽天使搏斗的无尽挣扎，无非是先前一次次崩塌泛起的残渣，在冒泡，直到我们都担心它会触发烟雾报警器。

lines.en: The unfortunate truth that serves as the jacket for the infinite emptiness is that the alarms are already blaring, though.
lines.zh: 然而，作为这无垠空虚外衣的不幸真相是——警报早就响成一片了。

lines.en: Too many anomalies had found themselves here for one reason or another. And Nodoka was special, yes. But she wasn’t the {i}only{/i} one special anymore. And that made things complicated.
lines.zh: 太多的异常者因为这样那样的理由来到了这里。Nodoka 是特别的，没错。但她不再是{i}唯一{/i}特别的那一个了。而这让事情变得复杂。

lines.en: Were these mysteries connected? Or was each iteration of exaggerated misery its own language?
lines.zh: 这些谜团是相连的吗？还是说，每一轮被夸张化了的苦难，都是各自独立的语言？

lines.en: It was all getting so tiring. Learning. Thinking. {i}Being.{/i} And while it seemed like such a place would be a playground for her, it was anything but.
lines.zh: 一切正变得越来越累人。学习。思考。{i}存在{/i}。虽然这样的地方看起来该是她的游乐场，但它恰恰相反。

lines.en: It was more like she was packed into the waiting room of an urgent care facility with a loved one bleeding out in her lap, forced to wait until her last name is shouted across a sea of separate dying onlookers.
lines.zh: 更像是她被塞进一家急诊诊所的候诊室，怀里躺着流血不止的至爱，被迫等着，直到在一片各自垂死的旁观者的汪洋里，有人喊出她的姓氏。

lines.en: Nodoka was good with her hands. She understood anatomy and medical science better than most nurses. So why would she wait here instead of just fixing the issue herself?
lines.zh: Nodoka 手很巧。她比大多数护士都懂解剖和医学。那她为什么要在这儿干等，而不是自己动手解决问题？

lines.en: She couldn’t come up with a reason. She couldn’t {i}care.{/i}
lines.zh: 她想不出理由。她也不{i}在乎{/i}。

lines.en: But she had never been good at that to begin with. And she didn’t care about {i}caring{/i} either. At least most of the time.
lines.zh: 可她本来就不擅长「在乎」。而她连「{i}在乎{/i}」本身也不在乎。至少大多数时候是这样。

lines.en: It was only when she was distracted that her judgment would lapse and she’d deceive herself into thinking she’s anything more than a ghost walking in the shadows of its prior self.
lines.zh: 只有在分心的时候，她的判断力才会失灵，才会自欺欺人地以为自己不只是个走在旧日自我的阴影里的鬼魂。

lines.en: Those old boots fit perfectly. But even then, she couldn’t fathom even {i}fathoming{/i} how Kyoko walked in them. The friends she made and the struggles she endured.
lines.zh: 那双旧靴子合脚得很。但即便如此，她也无法{i}想象{/i} Kyoko 穿着它们走路的样子——她交过的朋友，她熬过的苦难。

lines.en: And {i}oh,{/i} were there struggles.
lines.zh: {i}哦{/i}，那些苦难可真不少。

lines.en: Refocus. Rethink. Rewrite. Redo. Repair.
lines.zh: 重新聚焦。重新思考。重新书写。重新来过。重新修补。

lines.en: Pay no mind to these distractions — to these monsters knocking at your door and remember why you are here, Nodoka.
lines.zh: 别去理会这些打扰——别去理会那些敲你门的怪物，记住你为什么在这儿，Nodoka。

lines.en: Remember why I am here.
lines.zh: 记住我为什么在这儿。

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain15
She arrives back home. And when she does, everything looks just as grey as always.
lines.zh: 她回到了家。而到家时，一切都跟往常一样灰蒙蒙的。

lines.en: Scuff marks on the wooden floor from where Otoha would rock her chair back and forth to help her think. Coffee rings on stacks of research papers. Bits of wood from a dead tree that somehow kept on dying.
lines.zh: 木地板上有 Otoha 前后摇晃椅子帮自己思考时留下的划痕。一叠叠研究论文上的咖啡渍。一棵死掉的树上掉下的碎木屑——那棵树不知怎么还在继续死去。

lines.en: The faint hum of an old computer monitor was missing, though. Scratching from within a kitchen cabinet. {i}Harsher{/i} scratching in a closeted litter box.
lines.zh: 不过，旧显示器的微弱嗡鸣不见了。厨房柜子里传来抓挠声。壁柜里的猫砂盆里传来{i}更刺耳{/i}的抓挠声。

lines.en: Somewhere down the line, those things became music to her.
lines.zh: 不知从什么时候起，那些声音对她来说成了音乐。

lines.en: : Holy shit. You’re actually alive.
lines.zh: : 我操。你还真活着啊。

lines.en: And while she rarely grew tired of listening to them on repeat, she liked {i}these{/i} sounds too. These sounds of a separate world.
lines.zh: 虽然她很少听腻那些循环播放的声音，但她也喜欢{i}这些{/i}声音。这些属于另一个世界的声音。

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain16
That was just it, though. A {i}separate{/i} world.
lines.zh: 不过，也就仅此而已了。{i}另一个{/i}世界。

lines.en: Another piece of the puzzle that she wouldn’t think thrice of before slotting it into its designated resting place.
lines.zh: 又一块拼图——她不会想上三遍，就把它塞进指定的位置。

lines.en: She’d think {i}twice,{/i} though. And it wasn’t always that way.
lines.zh: 但她会想{i}两遍{/i}。而以前并非总是如此。

lines.en: She was changing, whether she accepted it or not.
lines.zh: 她在变，不管她接不接受。

lines.en: She was weakening.
lines.zh: 她在变弱。

lines.en: Just like the world itself.
lines.zh: 就像这个世界本身一样。

lines.en: : Where the fuck have {i}you{/i} been? And what makes you think you’re allowed to be so hot all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你他妈跑哪儿去了？还有，你凭什么觉得{i}自己{/i}可以突然变得这么辣？

lines.en: : You like the new outfit? I wore it just for you.
lines.zh: : 你喜欢这身新衣服？我特地为你穿的。

lines.en: : Well, it’d work if I knew literally nothing else about you. Now, what the hell’s going on? Did you throw your phone off of a cliff or something?
lines.zh: : 要是我对你别的事一无所知，那倒还管用。好了，到底怎么回事？你把手机扔下悬崖了还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain17
: I climbed into a rabbit hole and woke up in a strange, fantastical world. Had I known you’d miss me this much, I’d have offered to take you with me.
lines.zh: : 我爬进了一个兔子洞，醒来就到了一个奇异的幻想世界。早知道你会这么想我，我就该提议带上你一起。

lines.en: : Must’ve been a big fucking rabbit hole if you’ve been gone for an entire week.
lines.zh: : 你都消失了整整一个星期，那兔子洞肯定他妈的大得惊人。

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain18
: Come again?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Is everything okay? Like, I figured you were having another one of your {i}episodes,{/i} but to just straight up vanish for a week without so much as answering my calls and telling me to eat a dick was weird for even you.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？我是说，我以为你又在发作什么{i}毛病{/i}，但就这么干脆消失一周、连我电话都不接、连句「去你的」都不回，这对你来说都挺反常的。

lines.en: : I’ve been gone for a week?
lines.zh: : 我消失了一周？

lines.en: : {i}Yes,{/i} dude. I had to tell Imani you were on some sort of fucking book tour and now she knows you’re legit and is probably going to read your stupid Kumon-mi High fan-fic and subsequently ruin Akira’s entire harem.
lines.zh: : {i}是的{/i}，大姐。我不得不跟 Imani 说你在搞什么该死的签售巡演，现在她真信了，搞不好会去读你那破 Kumon-mi High 同人文，然后顺手毁掉 Akira 的整个后宫。

lines.en: : Fascinating. An entire week. And you didn’t think to come look for me?
lines.zh: : 有意思。整整一周。而你没想过要来找我？

lines.en: : Where {i}would{/i} I look? I don’t know your home address.
lines.zh: : 我去哪儿找？我又不知道你家地址。

lines.en: : Futaba does. I think. Did she come looking for me?
lines.zh: : Futaba 知道。我想。她来找过我吗？

lines.en: : Apparently not if that’s where you were. {i}Was{/i} it?
lines.zh: : 如果那{i}就是{/i}你去的地方，那显然没有。是那儿吗？

lines.en: : It’s where I was today. I can’t speak for the other six days I was apparently missing, though.
lines.zh: : 我今天是在那儿。至于我「失踪」的另外六天，我就说不准了。

lines.en: : So you were zoned out for all of them? And now you’re suddenly a hot goth girl? There’s no way that’s normal.
lines.zh: : 所以你这几天一直神游？然后突然变成了辣妹哥特？这绝对不正常。

lines.en: : You were kidnapped and brainwashed. Then probably released because you annoyed them or something. It’s the only logical explanation I can think of if you don’t have anything.
lines.zh: : 你被绑架洗脑了。然后大概是因为你把他们烦得受不了才被放出来的。如果你没别的话可说，这是我能想到的唯一合理解释。

lines.en: : Otoha, do you ever remember your dreams?
lines.zh: : Otoha，你记得自己的梦吗？

lines.en: : Only the sexual ones.
lines.zh: : 只记得那些色的。

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain19
: Mm...no. That’s not what I’m looking for.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不。那不是我要找的。

lines.en: : You can still tell me about them if you want, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你想讲，我还是可以听的。

lines.en: : I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我不想。

lines.en: : No, really. It’s okay.
lines.zh: : 不，真的。没关系的。

lines.en: : No. It’s not.
lines.zh: : 不。有关系。

lines.en: : How unfortunate. I imagine practically anything would arouse me right now if it’s truly been a week since I vanished.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。既然我真的消失了一周，我想现在几乎任何东西都能唤起我的性致。

lines.en: : I feel like you are {i}way{/i} less concerned about this than you should be. Like, if {i}I{/i} vanished for a week, I’d be freaking the fuck out right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你对这事儿的在意程度，{i}远{/i}低于你该有的。就好比要是{i}我{/i}消失一周，我现在早就吓疯了。

lines.en: : Did Akira ever come by?
lines.zh: : Akira 来过吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...once. Why?
lines.zh: : 呃……来过一次。怎么了？

lines.en: : For me?
lines.zh: : 找我？

lines.en: : Again, {i}why?{/i}
lines.zh: : 再说一次，{i}怎么了{/i}？

lines.en: : Just taking inventory on who is concerned about me. It may come in handy later.
lines.zh: : 只是清点一下谁在乎我。以后可能派得上用场。

lines.en: : What, you mean the next time you disappear for a week? Want to give me your address so I can come chase after you or something?
lines.zh: : 什么，你是指下次你又消失一周的时候？要不要把你的地址给我，好让我去追你之类的？

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain20
: Otoha, are we friends?
lines.zh: : Otoha，我们是朋友吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...yeah?
lines.zh: : 呃……是吧？

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Why...are we friends? Because we...I don’t know. We just are?
lines.zh: : 为什么……我们是朋友？因为我们……我不知道。我们就是啊？

lines.en: : Even when we don’t know anything about each other?
lines.zh: : 即使我们互不了解？

lines.en: : You’re being weird as fuck right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在怪得要命。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I didn’t realize it was a difficult question.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不知道这是个难题。

lines.en: : Listen, just...either give me your address or we can link our phones together so I can track you the next time you go missing.
lines.zh: : 听着，就……要么把你的地址给我，要么我们俩把手机连起来，这样下次你失踪我就能追踪到你。

lines.en: : I didn’t {i}want{/i} to start keeping tabs on you like Touka does with Yasu, but maybe Akira was right about you needing something like that even more than she does. I worry about you, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我本来不{i}想{/i}像 Touka 盯 Yasu 那样盯着你的，但也许 Akira 说得对——你比她更需要这种东西。我很担心你，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Why? I’m fine. And, upon further reflection, I don’t like the idea of you following me down the rabbit hole.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我很好。而且仔细想了想，我不太喜欢你跟着我跳进兔子洞这个主意。

lines.en: : Nodoka-
lines.zh: : Nodoka——

lines.en: : Please excuse me. I have no idea when the last time I ate was.
lines.zh: : 失陪了。我都不知道自己上一顿是什么时候吃的。

lines.en: scene nodokaupagain21
: Nodo- oh, come on!
lines.zh: : Nodo——哦，拜托！

lines.en: scene black
: I’m hungry too! But you’re gonna make me look like shit if I have to go out with you while you’re dressed like that!
lines.zh: : 我也饿啊！可你穿成这样，我要是跟你一起出门，岂不是被你衬得像坨屎！

lines.en: : I will tear the outfit in two so we can share. Would you like the top half, or the bottom?
lines.zh: : 我把这身衣服撕成两半，我们分着穿。你要上半身，还是下半身？

lines.en: : Neither! Just...keep them both to yourself!
lines.zh: : 都不要！就……两半都留着你自己穿吧！

lines.en: In the many documented worlds unseen, there are few I have the time to show you.
lines.zh: 在那众多有记载的不可见世界里，我有时间带你看的寥寥无几。

lines.en: This is not malicious on my end. Nor is it something I’m refusing for the sake of maintaining a thin layer of mystique.
lines.zh: 这并非出于恶意。也不是我为了维持一层薄薄的神秘感而拒绝展示。

lines.en: I just think there’s something special to be found in this one.
lines.zh: 我只是觉得，这一个世界里能找到某种特别的东西。

lines.en: A home for anomalies. For dreams and things like us.
lines.zh: 一个属于异常者的家。属于梦，以及像我们这样的东西。

lines.en: And if you think this home does not suit you, that’s fine.
lines.zh: 而如果你觉得这个家不适合你，那也没关系。

lines.en: If you’ve made it here, you’re always welcome.
lines.zh: 只要你走到了这儿，你永远受欢迎。

lines.en: These doors will never close.
lines.zh: 这些门永远不会关上。

lines.en: Also, I am a liar.
lines.zh: 另外，我是个骗子。

scene black

lines.zh: {i}Nodoka 的好感度提升到了 [nodoka_love]！{/i}
